S43.01.needs: an image file to upload; a Free account must use a model that accepts images
S43.01.note: The + button's label was not found in the code. Production can refuse uploads through the external scanner (UPLOAD_SCAN_WEBHOOK_URL), which is server configuration, not a control.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Click the round + button beside the message box (it has no visible words).
Click Add photos & files and choose one image.
Type "What is in this picture?" and send.
Compare: the answer describes what the image shows.
S43.01.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

S43.02.note: The + button has no visible words in the code. An attachment count limit applies per message.
steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and select two images at once.
Type "What is different between these two pictures?" and send.
Compare: the answer refers to both images.
S43.02.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

S43.03.needs: the desktop app; macOS may ask for screen recording permission (unknown)
S43.03.note: If the composer is not ready, the app copies the screenshot to the clipboard and tells the person to paste it, as the code shows.
steps: Open the desktop app and go to a chat.
Choose File > Screenshot to Chat and capture the screen as the app asks.
If the image does not appear in the message box, click the box and press Command-V.
Type "What does this screenshot show?" and send.
Compare: the answer explains the screenshot.
S43.03.where: File > Screenshot to Chat (desktop app), then the message box

S43.04.needs: a photo or scan of a document, or a PDF
S43.04.note: The composer has a conflict check for images and PDFs in one message (apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/ChatComposerNew.tsx); the exact warning text was not confirmed.
steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose a photo of a paper document or a scanned PDF.
Type "Read this document and explain it." and send.
Compare: the answer reads the text and explains it.
S43.04.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose a chart image.
Type "What trend does this chart show?" and send.
Compare: the answer reads the values and trends from the chart.
S43.05.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose a diagram image.
Type "Explain the structure of this diagram." and send.
Compare: the answer names the parts and how they connect.
S43.06.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose a photo of handwritten notes.
Type "Transcribe these notes." and send.
Compare: the answer gives the handwritten words.
S43.07.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

S43.08.note: The Copy message control's visibility on assistant replies was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose an image that contains text.
Type "Extract all the text in this image." and send.
Click Copy message under the reply and paste it somewhere to check.
Compare: the copied text matches the text in the image.
S43.08.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files, then the reply

steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose an image with several of one object.
Type "How many apples are in this picture?" (use the object in the image) and send.
Compare: the answer gives a count that matches the image.
S43.12.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and select two scene images.
Type "Describe the differences between these two scenes." and send.
Compare: the answer names differences that appear in the two images.
S43.13.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

S43.14.needs: a photo or screenshot of a problem
steps: Open a new chat and click the round + button beside the message box.
Click Add photos & files and choose a photo or screenshot of the problem (device, error or setup).
Type "What is wrong and how do I fix it?" and send.
Compare: the answer gives troubleshooting steps that match the picture.
S43.14.where: New chat > round + button beside the message box > Add photos & files

S43.17.needs: an image in the Library; an account that can create images (plan limits unknown)
S43.17.note: Remix shows only for image items. The menu trigger label for an item was not found. An earlier chat image can also be used through the Variation button in apps/web/features/chat/components/ImageGenerationCard.tsx.
steps: Click Library in the left sidebar.
Open the menu of an image item in the Library.
Click Remix.
Check the new chat: the image is attached and the menu "What to do with the attached image" shows.
Type an edit prompt, send, and compare: the new image is made from the chosen reference.
S43.17.where: Library > image item > Remix (a new chat opens with the image attached and Image mode on)
